_doc: Step 69 pacing baseline -- NOT a target. The owner asked for the work x2.5 slower again (balance.pace.work_scale 2.5 -> 6.25, construction x2.5) and for a slower feel rather than the old income back, so the frozen Step 50 targets (targets.json) no longer describe this game; they stay as they are, history, and tests/unit/sim/test_balance.gd still holds the game to them at the pace they were set for (Step 58's). This file is what the deterministic simulator measured on the Step 69 game, 'blind' profile (tools/balance_optimizer/optimize.gd --profile blind --minutes 240), on 2026-10-28: seconds of active play to each journey mark, money by 10 and 60 minutes, and the first moment the island can be sold. The test keeps the game within `tolerance` of it (a regression guard, both ways) and checks no dead end. Re-measure and rewrite this file only with a deliberate pace change, and say so in design/INCREMENTAL_BALANCE_REPORT.md.
